source: Five user photographs of Português a Valer 3 glossary: nutrir–pensão, lidar–mérito, gasóleo–incêndio, estufados–fibra, distraído–enoturismo; printed page numbers not visible
normalization_notes: Assistant visual transcription of the Portuguese and English glossary columns. Other languages and internal lesson-page references are not transcribed.
Printed page numbers are outside the frame on all five photographs. Keep page=null and stable image identifiers; do not guess pagination.
Original expressions, article annotations, capitalization and English glosses are preserved in source rows. Individual vocabulary is lowercase and NFC normalized.
Split phrases, optional grammatical words in constructions and reflexive clitics into separately translated components. Retain lexical compounds mal-humorado and matéria-prima.

The source label gordura poliinsaturada is retained; the enriched adjective is normalized to standard poli-insaturada. Keep other inflected forms such as lugares, marcados, grelos, guisados, hortícolas, processados, enchidos and enlatados distinct.
Assistant Ukrainian translations, per-word CEFR estimates, topic assignments, English corrections and component meanings are not independently reviewed. B1 is user-supplied book metadata.
Use existing topical and grammatical groups; source book and images remain metadata. No database connection, duplicate/conflict check or import is performed.
Each photograph has a separate extracted JSON backup; original photographs and a combined extracted and enriched batch are retained.

enrichment_provenance.english: Printed English retained unchanged in rows/source_senses; reuse where appropriate. Component translations and corrections are assistant supplied.
enrichment_provenance.groups: Assistant assignments to existing topic names.

corrections.note: Printed to request is incorrect for the standalone verb efetuar; preserve it verbatim in source rows.
Printed to catch fire is intransitive; incendiar is normally transitive. Catch fire is incendiar-se or pegar fogo.
Printed volume of air is less precise than the meteorological term air mass.
Source gloss designated seat is singular whereas the Portuguese label is plural.
Preserve printed poliinsaturada in the source label; prepare the standard hyphenated adjective poli-insaturada. Source gloss omits the noun fat.

corrections.corrected_english: to be needed; to be missed
corrections.note: The expression is perspectivally different from to miss; preserve original gloss as context. Components translated independently.
Printed interest (for) is contextual; use a noun gloss for standalone practice.

uncertainties: Printed page numbers are not visible on any of the five images; recorded as null, with stable image identifiers.
Expressions remain context-dependent; complete expressions and original glosses are retained in source rows.
Live database duplicate/conflict comparison has not run.
